row.title: Kernel 9.2.0 recognitions run as a lint checked against the pinned text
row.body: kernel --check now fails if any quoted signature in the pinned kernel's RECOGNITIONS section is not caught by the recognition lint in doctrine/kernel.json. All 38 signatures in 9.2.0 are caught today.
